senses.sense_definition: The philosophical theory that only one's own mind is sure to exist.

examples.text: The philosopher argued that <w>solipsism</w> is an impossible position to maintain in daily life.
Radical <w>solipsism</w> suggests that the external world is merely a projection of the individual consciousness.

senses.sense_definition: Extreme self-absorption or an unawareness of the needs and views of other people.

examples.text: His constant <w>solipsism</w> made it difficult for him to maintain long-term friendships.
The manager's <w>solipsism</w> prevented him from listening to the valid concerns of his team.
